title: 片開き窓ユニット
description: 透明ガラス入りの二枚建て窓。片側の開いたサッシ、気密材、丁番、ハンドル、排水隙間のある水切りを含む。 ゲーム・可視化向け。製造・構造設計・3Dプリント用途は未検証。
descriptionEn: A twin glazed casement unit with one sash statically open, transparent panes, seals, hinges, handles and a sill with real drainage gaps. For games and visualization; not validated for manufacture, structural engineering or 3D printing.
author: Xenoah
uv: Per-component primitive or automatically unwrapped UVs. Overlapping between components; not a packed unique lightmap atlas. Solid-color PBR materials; no external textures. STL has no colors or UVs. Glazing uses alpha-blended PBR transparency; appearance depends on viewer lighting and transparency sorting.

provenance.rights: Original geometry and material design created for Xenoah Meshcopia under the owner request for CC-BY-4.0 publication. No third-party meshes, scans, brands, logos or font files.

usages.context: Original city asset created for this library. No external deployment or reuse claimed.
